FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Technical Rebound Expected as Oversold RSI Meets Strong US Payrolls Catalyst
tldr_points: Strong US non-farm payrolls beat supports USD fundamentals.
USD/JPY trades significantly below MA20 at 159.07, signaling short-term capitulation.
RSI(14) at 31.8 indicates oversold conditions, favoring a tactical rebound.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY exhibits oversold RSI at 31.8 below MA20, while robust payrolls data provides fundamental support for a tactical rebound.
FX.comment: Oversold RSI at 31.8 combined with strong payrolls data suggests a tactical rebound toward the 20-day MA at 159.07.
